people.name: Syene
people.line: Southern border of Egypt, modern-day Aswan

translations.web: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.”
translations.bsb: Behold, they will come from far away, from the north and from the west, and from the land of Aswan.”
translations.kjv: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
translations.asv: Lo, these shall come from far; and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
